create_study_instance: create a Study instance by passing keyword arguments for name, description, external_study_url, and other fields
validate_study_schema: validate a Study instance against its JSON schema using the validate method with check_required_fields
serialize_study_to_dict: serialize a Study instance to a dictionary using the to_dict method for API payloads
inspect_study_attributes: inspect a Study instance attributes like status, reward, total_available_places, and progress_percentage
stringify_study: get a human-readable string representation of a Study instance showing its class name, id, and name
